name: control
label: Control (Loose Baseline)
profile: shipped baseline: dynamic 0.50x, 1-20c, 15c window, no widen snap-back, gate off
desc: Control. The shipped loose baseline with nothing changed; every other arm is read against it.
thesis: The shipped defaults are the reference: any change must beat this on risk-adjusted metrics.

name: balanced-only
label: Balanced Only
desc: The balanced preset: proportional volatility tracking inside a 2-4c band.
thesis: A 2-4c band trades some edge for reach, completing pairs faster while bounding adverse runs.

name: queue5-only
label: Queue Clear 5m Only
desc: Only quotes books whose queue is likely to clear inside five minutes.
thesis: A quote stuck behind a slow queue is dead capital; refusing slow books lifts Sharpe and limits drawdown.

name: balanced-queue5
label: Balanced + Queue Clear 5m
desc: Combines the balanced dynamic offset band with the 5-minute queue-clear refusal gate.
thesis: Testing whether pairing the balanced band and queue gate compounds risk-adjusted return or induces volume starvation.
